panels.description: Sum of Reps x Weight_kg across all sets in range (Weight_kg>0 only; excludes cardio warmups).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", sum("Reps" * "Weight_kg") AS "Total Volume" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("Reps" * "Weight_kg") > 0

panels.title: Total Volume

panels.description: Count of sets with Weight_kg > 0 in range. This excludes bodyweight/cardio-only entries (e.g. unweighted pull-ups, ROW/INDOOR_ROW warmups) that are logged inside strength activities but carry no load — so this number is lower than the raw row count for the same range. See 'Sets Needing Classification' below for data-quality flags.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", count("Reps") AS "Weighted Sets" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("Reps") > 0

panels.title: Weighted Sets

panels.description: Sum of reps across weighted sets in range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", sum("Reps") AS "Total Reps" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("Reps") > 0

panels.title: Total Reps

panels.description: Distinct days with at least one weighted set (one row per training day).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", count(dvol) AS "Workouts" FROM (SELECT date_bin('1 day', time, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') AS day, sum("Reps" * "Weight_kg") AS dvol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) d HAVING count(dvol) > 0

panels.title: Number of Workouts

panels.description: Mean per-workout training volume in range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", avg(dvol) AS "Avg Volume" FROM (SELECT date_bin('1 day', time, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') AS day, sum("Reps" * "Weight_kg") AS dvol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) d HAVING count(dvol) > 0

panels.title: Avg Volume / Workout

panels.description: Best estimated 1-rep max per exercise per workout day, using the Epley formula Weight_kg * (1 + Reps/30). Filter by $ExerciseCategory / $ExerciseLabel above. This is the single most useful panel for tracking progressive overload.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1d'), "ExerciseLabel" AS metric, max("Weight_kg" * (1 + "Reps" / 30.0)) AS e1rm FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "ExerciseCategory" IN ($ExerciseCategory) AND "ExerciseLabel" IN ($ExerciseLabel) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Estimated 1RM Progression (Epley) by Exercise

panels.description: Total volume (kg) per workout day (Reps x Weight_kg, summed across all weighted sets that day).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1d'), sum("Reps" * "Weight_kg") AS "Volume" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Training Volume per Workout

panels.description: Heaviest single set and best estimated 1RM (Epley) per exercise in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "Time", "ExerciseLabel", max("Weight_kg") AS "Max Weight (kg)", max("Weight_kg" * (1 + "Reps" / 30.0)) AS "Best Est. 1RM (kg)" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "ExerciseCategory" IN ($ExerciseCategory) AND "ExerciseLabel" IN ($ExerciseLabel) GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Personal Records (Top Set & Est. 1RM)

panels.description: Training volume (kg) split by exercise category — shows muscle-group balance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", "ExerciseCategory" AS metric, sum("Reps" * "Weight_kg") AS "Volume" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "ExerciseCategory" IN ($ExerciseCategory) GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Volume by Category

panels.description: Number of weighted sets per exercise category — complements the volume pie (a category can have many sets but low volume, or vice versa).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "Time", "ExerciseCategory", count("Reps") AS "Sets" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "ExerciseCategory" IN ($ExerciseCategory) GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Sets by Category

panels.description: Most recent individual sets: exercise, reps, weight, and volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "Time", "ExerciseLabel" AS "Exercise", "Reps", "Weight_kg" AS "Weight (kg)", "Reps" * "Weight_kg" AS "Volume (kg)", "SetOrder" AS "Set #" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "ExerciseCategory" IN ($ExerciseCategory) AND "ExerciseLabel" IN ($ExerciseLabel) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent Sets (Workout Detail)

panels.description: One row per workout day: total sets, reps, volume, and cumulative active set duration. Not filtered by exercise picker (whole-session view).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin('1 day', time, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') AS "Time", count("Reps") AS "Sets", sum("Reps") AS "Reps", sum("Reps" * "Weight_kg") AS "Volume (kg)", sum("Duration_s") AS "Time Under Tension (s)" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Workout Summary (per session)

panels.description: Time spent in each heart-rate zone during strength sessions, from StrengthHRZones. ZoneNumber/ZoneLowBoundary are per-activity fields (not tags), so each zone is queried as a separate target filtered by ZoneNumber.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", sum("SecsInZone") AS "Zone 1" FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE "ZoneNumber" = 1 AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("SecsInZone") > 0
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", sum("SecsInZone") AS "Zone 2" FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE "ZoneNumber" = 2 AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("SecsInZone") > 0
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", sum("SecsInZone") AS "Zone 3" FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE "ZoneNumber" = 3 AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("SecsInZone") > 0
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", sum("SecsInZone") AS "Zone 4" FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE "ZoneNumber" = 4 AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("SecsInZone") > 0
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", sum("SecsInZone") AS "Zone 5" FROM "StrengthHRZones" WHERE "ZoneNumber" = 5 AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("SecsInZone") > 0

panels.title: HR Zone Time Distribution (Strength Sessions)

panels.description: Total accumulated active-set duration (sum of Duration_s) per exercise in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "Time", "ExerciseLabel", sum("Duration_s") AS "Total Time Under Tension (s)" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "ExerciseCategory" IN ($ExerciseCategory) AND "ExerciseLabel" IN ($ExerciseLabel) GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Time Under Tension by Exercise

panels.description: Count of training days bucketed into weekly bins. fill(0) is intentional here: a week with no workout genuinely has zero, not missing data.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT date_bin('1 day', time, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') AS day, sum("Reps" * "Weight_kg") AS dvol FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) SELECT w.time, count(d.dvol) AS "Workouts" FROM generate_series((SELECT date_bin('1 week', min(day) FILTER (WHERE dvol IS NOT NULL), TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') FROM d), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 week') AS w(time) LEFT JOIN d ON d.day >= w.time AND d.day < w.time + interval '1 week' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Workouts per Week

panels.description: One cell per calendar day: green = at least one weighted set logged that day, gray = rest day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1d', 0), count("Reps") AS "Workout" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "Weight_kg" > 0 AND "ExerciseLabel" <> 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND "ExerciseCategory" <> 'RUN' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Workout Calendar

panels.description: Sets Garmin could not classify into an exercise (ExerciseCategory=UNKNOWN). Not dropped from other panels, but flagged here — fix labels in Garmin Connect to improve categorization.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", count("Reps") AS "Unknown" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "ExerciseCategory" = 'UNKNOWN' AND $__timeFilter(time) HAVING count("Reps") > 0

panels.title: Sets Needing Classification (UNKNOWN)

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT "ExerciseLabel" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "ExerciseCategory" IN ($ExerciseCategory) ORDER BY 1
list.name: ExerciseLabel
list.label: Exercise
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT "ExerciseLabel" FROM "StrengthExerciseSet" WHERE "ExerciseCategory" IN ($ExerciseCategory) ORDER BY 1
